_note: Cycle narrative of the single-cycle view (spec WS-F-033). Written afresh for the simulator (C4) in the register-transfer notation of Chapter 6 and NOTATION_GUIDE.md sec. 4: R[n] a register, M[a] a data-memory word, <- (shown as an arrow) a transfer at the clock edge that ends the cycle. Status: approved by the author on 2026-10-26. Each class gives a symbolic line (rtn) and the same transfer with this cycle's values (val). Placeholders in braces are filled by src/ui/single-view.js.

lbu.rtn: R[rd] ← byte of M[R[rs1] + imm], zero-extended

branch.rtn: if {cond_sym}: PC ← PC + imm, otherwise PC ← PC + 4

x0: rd is x0: the register file discards the write, and x0 stays 0.
halt: jal x0, 0 is the halt instruction: the program ends here, and the instruction is not executed.
unknown: This word is not an instruction of the single-cycle processor; the main decoder gives 0 for every control signal.
